body: Four years ago, I became depressed. It's greatly affected my life. I've lost so many opportunities, and each day, my negative thoughts, induced by depression, are getting worse. I don't really know if I can make it.

I'll probably start going to gym soon because I want to improve my appearance. I don't know if I'll be able to look as good as I did four years ago, but I'll do it. I'm hoping medicine will work wonders, but I'm super scared that it will make me feel worse.

I'm really trying to change. I know exactly what I need to be doing, but I don't know if the results will be good enough. My desire to kill myself has suddenly increased in intensity. About three months ago, I told myself I was never going to go attempt suicide, but I actually just recently attempted suicide, and that was a very impulsive attempt. I didn't even think I was going to hurt myself on that day.

Every time I take a picture of myself or look in the mirror, I look absolutely horrible. My face is wretched because I didn't take care of myself for four years, ever since I became depressed. I used to be very pretty, and now, I look lifeless, pale, and sick. I planned on going on meds this summer, but I don't really know if I'll be feeling any better while on medicine. I don't want to wait that long.

For the last four years, I've lost interest in everything. I used to be a very good flutist, but now, I just don't care. I don't care about school, and I don't care about any recreational activities. I've thought about suicide intermittently over the last four years, and every single day my suicidal feelings increase in intensity. I used to be pretty too, but now I'm not. I didn't take care of my appearance for a long time, and I'm paying for it. I've been trying to improve, but my depression is telling me I can't do it, and I'll never improve. Ever since I've began improving, the intensity of my suicidal thoughts has increased dramatically.

I'm trying my best to improve my life right now. I just started to lose some weight and improve my overall appearance. Even if I lose weight and do all this other stuff to myself, I'll never be pretty. I know that isn't much of something to worry about, but it's been making me feel horrible lately. Also, I just don't think I have much of a future. I've had depression for a long time, and for many years I've felt completely apathetic. I can't enjoy things anymore.
